rev.t: Good studio though it's small in size. The only big concern is that it is located inside a men's hostel and is super hard to find. Please add a board guys!

We had a great time jamming here... The room is spacious for a 4-5 member band. The audio equipment is top-notch. The drums is a stellar Tama kit which is a joy to play! Really loved the support from the team to have us set up on dot time …

Great place for jamming.
We enjoyed a lot. They have a great drum kit and the room is sufficiently spacious. Mics, amps, drums and other instruments are included in the hourly rental …
